$comment: Triaged high/critical npm advisories (NFR-06, SECURITY-10). Reasoning: Docs/DiagnosticRuns/bt-audit-triage.md. Checked by scripts/audit-gate-cli.ts in CI; a new high advisory fails until it is added here with a decision.

advisories.reason: No fixed braces release exists (<=3.0.3 affected, 3.0.3 is the latest). Runtime path ts-morph -> @ts-morph/common -> fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces expands glob patterns from the evaluated project's tsconfig include/exclude and the local CLI; worst case a crafted pattern crashes the local evaluation (stack exhaustion, DoS), no data exposure. The dev path (jest -> micromatch) runs only on this repository's own config. Removal needs ts-morph 28 and jest 30 (semver-major), outside Build and Test.
